title: Too hard to remove -- IGNORE THE OTHER FAKE REVIEWS
text: Too hard to remove -- IGNORE THE OTHER FAKE REVIEWS. Here's what you REALLY need to know:  Filled up ice to 1/5" from to top like directions said to do, still like ripping a phone book in half in order to get the cubes out because they are not spaced far enough apart, there's only 1/16" of rubber between each cube so they press up against each other when trying to contort the rubber to get them out.  They don't fall out either after your contort it, you have to pretty much push each cube out from the back and they don't pop out.  You will spend 2 minutes getting the ice cubes out after a long vigorous thumb war battle.  After I got first batch out the rubber was contorted/out of square so I'm thinking second batch will probably be worse.  I might need to run some water over the ice to make it easier to get out, but if you do that and put it in your icebox, they will all meld together in some giant ice stalactite impossible to get out unless you have an ice hammer to chisel it apart.  Sorry, this is a Failure, send the engineers back to TEST 101, looking for some Continuous Improvement.  They just shipped this product to turn a quick buck, not because it was any good.  Save yourself the disappointment.
